objective.text: Distinguish an absent translation key from a translated empty string.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish a deliberately empty PHP translation from an absent key.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The current locale is en. There are no JSON translation overrides or custom missing-key callbacks.

options.rationale: This treats the existing PHP language-file entry as absent solely because it is empty.
options.misconception: This treats the existing PHP language-file entry as absent solely because it is empty.

options.rationale: An absent key is not automatically translated to an empty string.
options.misconception: An absent key is not automatically translated to an empty string.

options.rationale: The PHP translation file provides an empty string for notice; the absent key falls back to its key text.
The helper does not stringify these cases as the text null.
options.misconception: The helper does not stringify these cases as the text null.
